acceptance_contract: POST /api/vehicles/resolve returns exactly one vehicle context or a typed refusal; no partial or ambiguous context is returned
a transition cannot start from client-supplied labels; resolution must have committed first
changing an upstream cascade field clears every incompatible downstream value
a cascade step with a single real option collapses and does not appear
a vehicle failing any of the eleven readiness stages is absent from the selector and unreachable by direct request
Garage records persist server-side and restore by stable ID, not by label
reading or mutating another customer's Garage record is refused server-side (negative object-level authorization, S2 mandatory)
exactly one vehicle per customer is primary; setting a new primary clears the previous one atomically
SelectVehicle, AddVehicle and CreateVehicleProfile are idempotent under retry with the same idempotency key
VehicleSelected, VehicleAdded and VehicleProfileCreated are outboxed before any projection reads them
on release supersession an unambiguous match is retained automatically; an ambiguous one enters BLOCKED pending customer confirmation
no saved vehicle is reattached to a different maker, family or chassis without explicit customer confirmation
both Garage actions resolve the same context; Open EPC categories reaches EPC without the transition running
committed cascade values meet WCAG AA contrast in their faint state and retain their accessible names
allowed actions are derived server-side from state; the client never decides which commands are offered
rate limiting applies to resolve and Garage mutation (S2 abuse control)
a masked VIN is never returned in a list response; only on explicit single-record read by the owner
support access to a customer's vehicle context requires an open case reference and is audited

permission_model.note: .own permissions evaluate against the record's owner, never against the request. .support and .merge are separate roles and may not be held by the same Position as a customer-facing operator (SoD).
permission_model.delegation: read.delegated is granted through VHUB-F013 vehicle sharing and is revocable by the owner.

inventory_effect: resolve through InventoryMovement / catalogue truth; no balance edits
acceptance_contract: a model with any one of the eleven stages not passing is not customer-ready, for every stage taken individually
customerReady is true only when all eleven stages pass
the first blocking stage reported is the earliest failing stage in ladder order
every blocker on a failing stage appears in the evaluation blocker list; a failing stage that states nothing still reports one
a stage with no evidence is never a pass
FITMENT_READY passes only when every variant carries a resolved fitment identity, and blocks when any does not
HOTSPOT_READY passes only when every diagram carries position hotspots, and blocks while diagram identity collisions remain
an acquisition-backlog model is never customer-visible and never counted as observed
no ledger entry is customerVisible while its evaluation is not customerReady
globalDiagramIdentitySafe is true exactly when the cross-maker collision count is zero, in both directions
a failing integrity gate names node_id or DGM in its notes
combined maker and model counts lie between the larger input and the sum, and customer-ready models never exceed observed models
DIAGRAM_READY requires positive evidence that stable DGM IDs were minted, not merely the absence of cross-maker node_id collisions, and HOTSPOT_READY is held behind it

permission_model.note: evaluate is a non-destructive computation; publish changes what the customer selector honours. They are separate permissions and may not be held by the same automated identity (SoD).
permission_model.delegation: none — catalogue readiness is not delegable to a customer identity.
